media.title: Jeanette MacDonald — studio portrait, 1930s
media.altText: Black-and-white studio portrait of the singer and actress Jeanette MacDonald, 1930s.
media.publicCaption: Jeanette MacDonald in an undated studio portrait of the 1930s. MacDonald introduced “San Francisco”, by Kaper and Jurmann with words by Gus Kahn, in the MGM film of 1936; the song carried the picture and outlived it.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States: Wikimedia Commons records the photograph as published between 1931 and 1977 without a copyright notice and also applies a United Kingdom tag for anonymous works. The claim rests on the uploader's inspection of the unmarked print rather than on an identified publication; the file cites only a photo-gallery web article, so the image's provenance remains limited.
